title: Vibe Coding: High-Velocity Orchestration
body: I use AI not as a replacement for thinking, but as a tool to fight entropy. In the 'Proof' project, this allowed synchronizing Web3 (TON), AI (Gemini), and Backend (Supabase) in record time, while maintaining 92% test coverage.
microCopy: Syntax is a commodity. Logic is the value. Architecture is the vibe.
